linux-hiby-rs6 apk repository

postmarketOS edge packages for the HiBy RS6 (aarch64), built by GitHub Actions from the pmos branch of linux-hiby-rs6 (commit @PMOS_SHA@).

To use it on the RS6, as root:

wget -O /etc/apk/keys/@KEY_NAME@.pub @REPO_URL@/@KEY_NAME@.pub
echo @REPO_URL@/edge >> /etc/apk/repositories
apk update
apk upgrade

Files: edge/aarch64/APKINDEX.tar.gz, package list, signing key.
